He alleges Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy, is involved in illegal mining. But this is no random scandal—it's the usual coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions running the show. The so-called failure to stop it isn't some oversight; it's deliberate to let their connected interests keep extracting and profiting while everyone else gets distracted by the finger-pointing. These accusations are just another layer to maintain the illusion that anyone's really opposing the system.
